reviews.text: I honestly like it I drink it every morning with hot chocolate! it doesn't really taste good but with the hot chocolate you can't really taste it as much it does help with going to the bathroom to be honest I've noticed that and it does help me remember I will be buying another one
reviews.zh: 老實講我幾鍾意，每朝都會配熱朱古力飲！佢本身個味唔係好好，但係有咗熱朱古力，就冇咁易食到個味。老實講，我留意到佢真係有助排便，而且佢真係令我記得要再買一盒。

reviews.text: Only had it for a few days so a bit early to tell, but whether it is just placebo effect or for real, I do feel slightly more energetic in the last few days. Instead of taking it in the morning, I add it to a cup of hot/warm water as a pick-me-up drink in the afternoon. While some may find it a little bitter, I love the fact that it is not loaded with sugar. Ginseng IS supposed to taste bitter!
reviews.zh: 我只係飲咗幾日，所以仲未能夠講得準，但係無論係安慰劑效應定係真係有效，我近幾日都覺得精神好少少。我唔係朝早飲，而係下晝加入一杯熱或者溫嘅水，當係提神飲品。雖然有啲人可能覺得有少少苦，但係我好鍾意佢唔係加咗好多糖。人參本身就應該係苦嘅！

reviews.text: I am very satisfied with this product. The red ginseng extract provides a clear and consistent boost of energy that lasts throughout the day. I feel more focused, balanced, and physically stronger without any side effects. The packaging is convenient, and the sticks are easy to take daily. Overall, a high-quality supplement that delivers exactly what it promises.
reviews.zh: 我對呢款產品好滿意。紅參萃取提供清晰、穩定嘅能量，可以維持成日。我覺得更加專注、平衡，身體亦都更加強壯，冇任何副作用。包裝方便，條裝亦都容易每日飲用。總括嚟講，係一款高質素嘅補充劑，兌現咗佢所承諾嘅效果。

reviews.text: I love this ginseng, I took it mostly everyday and skipping a few days every couple weeks or so. I never once got sick or caught anything the entire time I was using it. It wasn’t overstimulating either, although I did make a point to only take it at the beginning of the day.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款人參（ginseng），我大部分日子都會食，每隔幾個禮拜會停幾日。用緊嗰段時間，我一次都冇病過，亦冇染到任何疾病。佢都唔會太刺激，不過我特登只係朝早先食。

reviews.text:
This Korean Red Ginseng Extract Pure Stick Gold from BOTO has become part of my daily routine. I’ve been taking one stick every morning and I honestly feel more energized and focused throughout the day — especially helpful as a working mom with a busy schedule.

The taste is a bit strong and earthy (as expected with red ginseng), but I don’t mind it at all — actually, it feels kind of comforting now. I love that it’s vegan and comes in individual sticks, so it’s super convenient to take on the go or even while traveling.

I also appreciate the clean ingredients and that it’s a 6-year-old red ginseng extract. Definitely a great supplement if you’re looking for a natural way to support your energy, concentration, and overall vitality.
reviews.zh:
BOTO 嘅呢款韓國紅參萃取 Pure Stick Gold 已經成為我嘅日常一部分。我每朝食一條，老實講，我全日都覺得更有精神、更能專注——尤其係對於一個日程好忙嘅上班媽媽嚟講，好有幫助。

味道有啲濃，帶啲泥土味（紅參本身就係咁），但係我完全唔介意——其實而家反而覺得幾安慰。我好鍾意佢係純素嘅，而且係獨立包裝，所以外出甚至旅行時都超方便。

我仲欣賞佢嘅成分乾淨，而且係 6 年根紅參萃取。如果你想搵一個天然方法支持精力、專注力同整體活力，呢款絕對係好嘅補充劑。

reviews.text:
Wow it does not taste good but the small amount is easy enough to swallow quickly and follow with a sweeter vitamin gummy. That's how I take it any way. Plus you get use to the herbal taste after a while.

Might be a placebo effect or not but I feel more energized after taking it. Can't say yet as I just started taking it. Will update later.
reviews.zh:
哇，味道唔係好好，但係份量少，所以好容易快快手吞低，之後跟住食一粒甜啲嘅維他命軟糖。我一直都係咁食㗎。而且飲咗一段時間之後，你就會慣咗個草本味。

可能係安慰劑效應，又或者唔係，但係食咗之後我覺得精力多咗。我而家啱啱開始食，所以仲未能夠講。之後會再更新。

reviews.text: I’ve been drinking it for 3 weeks now, the sachets contain a liquid extract that needs to be mixed with water once a day, the taste is similar to dried plum. It’s too early to talk about the result since I will order more, but there are no negative side effects, I feel good, I have more energy
reviews.zh: 我飲咗三個星期，小包入面係液體萃取，每日要加水調勻一次，味道似西梅乾。講效果仲太早，因為我會再訂，但係冇任何負面副作用，我覺得好好，精力都多咗。

reviews.text: The packaging is pure luxury! Love how it looks, got one for myself and one for my mom and she was very impressed! The taste however… I’m glad I have tried gluthathione supplements before trying this, so it wasn’t such a terrible shock. If I hadn’t had anything ‘interesting’ tasting supplements before I might have given both boxes to my mom! 😂 She wasn’t shocked by the taste and said it is better than most. Hope this helps us to endure this winter! It sure gave me some energy, and I have just started taking it!
reviews.zh: 包裝超豪華！好鍾意個樣，我買咗一盒俾自己，一盒俾我媽媽，佢都好欣賞！不過味道……我好彩之前試過谷胱甘肽補充劑，所以冇咁大衝擊。如果我之前冇試過咁「有特色」味道嘅補充劑，我可能會將兩盒都俾咗我媽媽！😂 佢冇被味道嚇親，仲話比大部分都好。希望可以幫我哋捱過呢個冬天！真係俾咗啲精神我，而我啱啱先開始飲！
